story_section.description: Our karisalankani(Bhringaraj) kajal brings you the absolute purest form of traditional eye care. Made using the sacred, hand gathered soot offresh karisankani leaves and unrefined castor oil and pure ghee. Every swipe acts as a protective, cooling shield against heat.
main_benefits: Provides natural pigment, Heals cracked lips,
Provides a smooth base and acts as a sun protection.
safety_warnings: Do a patch test before applying.
how_to_use: Clean your eye are and take the required amount of kajal using the applicator and apply either in lower lid or upper lid of eyes. You can lightly dust a tiny amout of natural starch powder like arrowroot powder or tapioca powder to prevent smudging
